text.content:
Trigger: Situations resembling the character's original trauma.

Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) arises in response to severe trauma such as combat, rape, or servitude to a Tzimisce domitor. A ghoul who has been the subject of his master's latest experiment in superdermal bone art, or who watched his hungry master devour his mortal family, might develop this derangement; it can afflict vampires just as readily, perhaps those who survived a Lupine attack or awoke one night to find their haven ablaze.

Symptoms manifest as recurrent, debilitating flashbacks and extreme avoidance of situations likely to recreate the initial trauma. The player of a ghoul or Cainite afflicted with PTSD must spend a point of Willpower for the character to enter such a situation. If compelled by a blood bond or other form of control, the sufferer's player cannot spend Willpower to gain automatic successes on any roll, and all of the character's dice pools are halved (round down) for the duration. In any circumstance, botched Willpower rolls or other appropriate stimuli induce flashbacks of the traumatic episode with the same penalties. Ghouls laboring under this disorder are often disposed of by their domitors — Clan Tzimisce requires servants made of sterner stuff.

vtmlarp.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
